description: Agreed Diversion Routes Area 12 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Data Mill North. A shapefile to show the agreed diversion routes from the Strategic Road Network on to Local Authority roads. Diversion routes cover Area 12 of the SRN Yorkshire and the Humber. The diversion routes are currently being reconstructed from.pdfs and resurveyed as to their ongoing suitability. Coverage: Area 12 of the SRN, Yorkshire and the Humber. The portal files it under the publisher Data Mill North. It offers 8 resource(s) in CPG, DBASE, PRJ, SBN, SBX. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
